answer: Each bonded identity posts collateral to an escrow, so splitting control across k identities does not dilute evidence of coordinated equivocation: pairwise-linked offenses incur penalties that grow as O(k²). Like a canyon network, juniper roots, or ocean currents, apparent separation does not erase correlation.
